sources.entry: MessagesHistoryBrowser - macOS application to comfortably browse and search through your Messages.app history.

summary.one_liner: MessagesHistoryBrowser is a macOS app for browsing and searching your Messages.app chat history.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short: it describes the project as a macOS/OSX app for comfortably browsing and searching through Messages.app history. It points to an external app page for more information. The README does not list specific features, setup steps, or technical details. The repository was listed in serhii-londar/open-source-mac-os-apps under the Chat section.
use_cases: browse old iMessage conversations on a Mac
search past text messages on macOS
find an old message in a conversation
notable: Browses and searches the Messages.app history on macOS
Listed as an open-source Mac app in the Chat category
caveats: README is minimal; no install or usage instructions given
Works only on macOS/OSX, per the README description
